conflicting_evidence: Same gold annotation resolves to brivaracetam on every other field: CUIPhrase='brivaracetam', CUI='C1699861', and the annotated span text is 'Brivetiracetam-' (a typo of brivaracetam). DrugName is the sole field naming perampanel.
notes: Found in Phase 0 pipeline assumption audit (docs/research/exectv2_pipeline_assumption_audit_2026-07-02.md, 'Drug-lexicon gaps' section) and confirmed on the frozen dev140 corpus in Phase 3. Frozen corpus NOT edited. Effect on scoring: under canonicalize_medication_name the gold clinical_headline key carries name='perampanel' while a model prediction matching the span ('Brivetiracetam'->brivaracetam) keys to name='brivaracetam', so this fact cannot be a true positive regardless of model correctness (mislabels a defensible prediction as FP+FN).
